excluded.reason: Copyright notice only; no explicit redistribution licence on the reviewed source page.

excluded.reason: Source permission imposes a doctrinal condition on redistributors, so it is not a general public redistribution grant.

excluded.reason: Separate licence review required; verse-only display would omit the integral translators’ notes.

no_derivatives_handling: CC BY-ND and CC BY-NC-ND editions receive format conversion only; translated words and punctuation are not revised; headings, notes, cross references and front/back matter are omitted from display while the raw source and complete notices remain in the source archives.

verification.runtime: Chromium headless: all 116 new editions load through ReaderOffline.loadBook; representative preserved editions (swe-1917, fin-kr1938) load; search indexes build and match for new and old editions; offline save path verified.

scope_note: This package is third-party reference material for consultation alongside The Way Version. It is not a The Way Version release and does not modify current-form-documents/ or the mobile reader feed.
